band_contract.easy: Observed direct inverse-sine linear substitution, including integer and radical inner factors; no constant extraction.
band_contract.moderate: Observed constant-radicand normalization with u=x/a; independent unit, integer, and fractional numerators.
band_contract.hard: Authored composition: extract a nonunit constant and handle a non-square x coefficient; same linear substitution and arcsine primitive. No imported hard calibration.

sampling: Structural case first; independent positive exact coefficient roles. No global source-number substitution. Mathematical task deduplication across a batch.
limits: Finite bounded catalogs; count 1..100 is an input limit, not a guarantee of that many distinct tasks. Explicit exhaustion. Secant easy has a small integer matching-differential catalog.
